bagPolicy.summary: Bags up to 29.7 cm x 21 cm x 15 cm (DIN A4) are allowed. Backpacks of any kind and suitcases are prohibited.
allowed: Bags up to 29.7 x 21 x 15 cm (DIN A4)
prohibited: Bags larger than 29.7 x 21 x 15 cm
bagPolicy.note: These are the stadium house rules. Organizers can set different rules for a specific event, so check the event's safety notes.

parking.note: Parking is accessible via Flatowallee for those coming from different directions. Specific parking options and pricing details are not provided on the website.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Olympiastadion's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Aramark Restaurations GmbH provides catering services at the Olympiastadion in Berlin, offering a unique and creative culinary experience for various events. They cater to concerts, sports events, and private occasions, ensuring a diverse range of food and drink options for up to 75,000 spectators.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Enter the grounds through the East Gate or South Gate. Wheelchair-accessible entrances to the lower concourse are at blocks C/D, G/H, J/K, N, Q/R, and S/T, and wheelchair spaces are in sections Q to T, G to K, N, and the VIP grandstand, with companion seats beside each space. The upper tier is reachable only by stairs.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Olympiastadion's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: The Olympiastadion visitor center does not sell tickets for events. For Hertha BSC home games, tickets are sold at the stadium fan shop.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: The stadium has an East Gate and a South Gate. For the South Gate, take the Flatowallee exit (about 200 meters, event days only); for the East Gate, take the Trakehner Allee exit (about 250 meters).
